backtest_protocol.execution_model: Quarterly net_income and operating_cash_flow are known by their SEC filed date (<= signal date), matched on the same quarterly period end, and compared with the prior-year comparable quarter. Total assets uses the latest filed value. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: Quarterly cash-conversion improvement in SEC Companyfacts can sharpen the rejected annual accruals lead by requiring the latest reported quarterly operating-cash-flow/net-income ratio to improve versus the prior-year comparable quarter while keeping next-open default-off paper execution fixed.
interpretation: The quarterly cash-conversion improvement source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). Do not promote or tune this fixed quarterly improvement definition on the same frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs a materially different earnings-quality construction (for example true PIT TTM accruals built from annual-plus-YTD facts, forward closed replacement-value rows, or a new ownership/borrow/options context), not a sweep of quarterly ratio, improvement, freshness, RS, close, volume, top-N, hold, or cooldown thresholds.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping quarterly cash-conversion ratio, prior ratio, improvement gap, accruals/assets threshold, fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Need true PIT TTM same-period accruals or closed forward replacement-value rows before revisiting quarterly cash-flow quality.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.0581; aggregate PnL delta $+1,070.77; max drawdown drift -0.0001; 32 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Rejected. Quarterly cash-conversion improvement plus liquid SPY-relative confirmation did not clear Gate 4 versus the accepted compression/distribution comparators (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The likely failure is thin and concentrated clean-quarterly cash-flow coverage; the few eligible rows do not reliably beat existing momentum/relation paper sources after next-open execution and costs.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: production-universe names whose latest reported quarterly operating cash flow backs net income better than the prior-year comparable quarter, while same-day price action confirms liquid SPY-relative demand, should be a sharper version of the annual cash-conversion lead.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-016/017/019 and exp-2026060: Accepted/rejected fundamental_growth_rs Companyfacts support fields and the prior cash-conversion support field rode the accepted operating-profit + RS sleeve; they did not test a standalone quarterly improvement candidate source.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-020: Annual accruals / cash-conversion candidate pool was positive in all three windows but rejected because full deployment worsened drawdown by +5.22pp.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-021 and exp-20260614-023: Low-deployment and protective-stop retries failed; this run does not retune deployment, stop, annual ratio, price guards, hold, or cooldown. It changes the PIT quality discriminator.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression and distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Annual cash conversion was positive but overdeployed in exp-20260614-020; a latest-quarter improvement field is a distinct PIT Companyfacts discriminator, not a threshold/cap/stop retry. Risk is thin sample and concentration because few tickers report clean quarterly operating cash flow.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing current/prior comparable quarterly net_income and operating_cash_flow, missing assets, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT quarterly cash-conversion improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
